title: Louver panel
notes: Horizontal louver screen: top slabs (or closed top trapdoors) in the wall plane, so the half-height gap shows the dark backing as slats (stripe technique, Detail p.13; Harlo tall-louver). repeat_u and stacked per 2 rows. Cell "props" are merged into the palette block only where that block has the property (format note in COMPONENTS.md).
